names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 17 noiembrie, «Sfântul Cuvios Zaharia»; the account the calendar links is headed «Cizmarul care descuia ușile cu rugăciunea» and names him in its last paragraph.

feast.note: The calendar's line is bare, «Sfântul Cuvios Zaharia»; what identifies him is the account it links, of the cobbler of Constantinople who opened the doors of Hagia Sophia with his prayer.
